Use it at cafés, restaurants and bakeries.

caption:
Want your food to go in Korea? Say this 🥡
포장해 주세요 (po-jang hae ju-se-yo) = please pack it to go. Works at cafés, bakeries, and for leftovers at restaurants.
Save this for your trip.
Dari launches 25 Nov. Waitlist in bio.
